notes.title: Pixeljam's Dino Run 2 Kickstarter Campaign
notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p][/p][p]Pixeljam has always worked on multiple projects at once, and the thing we've probably spent the most time on is a sequel to our 2008 browser game [b]Dino Run.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032769/5d81a15e7389bb67a1a0aad4d73cec0ae03f0fec.png"][/img][/p][p]It's pixel art prehistoric multiplayer platformer with world-building tools included to let people create and share their own experiences.[/p][p]We've been either dreaming, planning, or developing for it since 2012 or so. We finally have enough momentum to make a final push to get to Early Access release on Steam, and if you are curious about it, please [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fpixeljam%2Fthe-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign%3Fref%3D9aoxr8" style="button"]click here to check out the Kickstarter Campaign[/url] we just launched.[/p][p][/p][p]Everyone that backs it will get immediate access to the current [b]Multiplayer Sandbox[/b], where you can explore & experiment, design & destroy, hang out and have fun alone or with friends:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032769/3f1c7e23b2f891a3e5051580a3045158574ade27.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: //// GRID RANGER Version 1.0 Is Live \\\\
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We're excited to announce that Grid Ranger is officially out of Early Access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032769/6e9025cc259fcb1ccfb7454782c97854fd6d080a.gif[/img]

[b]Version 1.0 features:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Engine improvements[/b], support for >60Hz monitors (press SHIFT during the initial boot-up screen to fiddle with the controls)
[*] [b]Infinite mode[/b]: an endless level with ever-increasing speed and difficulty (can be played in Normal or Hardcore)
[*] [b]Controller support[/b] (still not recommended, but supported now - L and R thumbsticks provide fast/broad and slow/fine-tuned movement, right trigger fires)
[*] UI can be traversed with keyboard or controller
[*] [b]Autofire[/b] toggle now available via menu
[/list]
We also just launched the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51738/Grid_Ranger_Game__Sountrack/]Game & Soundtrack Bundle[/url] and added one more new track from Infinite Mode.

There have been a few other small QoL features that people have asked for recently that I will look into soon - this is not the 100% end of updates, but it's most likely the end of new major features.

Thanks to everyone for supporting this little coding adventure of mine!  This is the first Pixeljam game that I've created from start to finish in a [i]very[/i] long time.  Huge thanks to [b]Datassette[/b] for making the V99 engine as well, which of course this game could not exist without.   I've already started on a new vector-styled game and I'm excited to show it off later in the year.  It's a very different direction than Pixeljam has ever gone...  :)

Take care,

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: GRID RANGER Leaves Early Access on March 25th
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We're pleased to announce that Grid Ranger will officially reach version 1.0 and leave early access on [b]March 25th, 2025[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032769/dff21fea08db00b89e46c8bd255a1c0569ef1bd3.gif[/img]

The final features include:

[list]
[*] [b]Infinite mode[/b]: an increasingly challenging endless level set to brand new music, available in normal and hardcore difficulties.
[*] [b]Autofire toggle[/b]: give your finger a rest and easily toggle on/off autofire during gameplay
[*] Support for above 60Hz monitors
[/list]

There is also controller support if you really want to use one, but the game was built around mouse controls and we don't recommend it! :)

Shortly after Grid Ranger's release, we will start teasing some screens from my next endeavor with the V99 engine.  We're only just getting started with it....

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: Version 1.0 is almost ready - help us test it?
notes.notes:
Hello Rangers,

Release Candidate Version 1.0 is currently in the Beta Branch and ready to test.  This contains all of the features for leaving Early Access:

- Infinite mode w new music
- Controller support (although mouse is still heavily recommended)
- Support for >60Hz monitors (press SHIFT during the animated boot-up screen to fiddle with the controls)
- Autofire toggle now available via menu

Please give it a whirl and let us know what you think in the forums.

Thanks, 

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: / HARCORE MODE ACTIVATED \
notes.notes:
Hello all,

The first major update to Grid Ranger is live - version 0.752.  Adding:

- [b]Hardcore Mode[/b]: toggle this on and off via the title screen options menu.  Hardcore mode introduces an extra challenge for seasoned players, and a new color scheme for each level as well.

- [b]Steam Achievements[/b]: including a special one for a 1 credit clear! (both in Normal and Hardcore modes)

Next up will be work on an entirely new game mode (Infinite), which should be ready for testing in February.

Starting at 1 PM EST today (Jan 13), the game will be 20% off for the next 2 weeks as well, including the soundtrack.

Also, please consider leaving a review, if you haven't done so yet!

Thanks for the support,

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: Beta Test The New HARDCORE Mode?
notes.notes:
Hello Rangers,

There is a new game mode to test - HARDCORE.  Switch on over to the BETA branch and then toggle it on from the options menu.  It features a brand new color palette for each level, increased difficulty and higher possible scores. Let us know what you think in the comments here or in the forums!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Intel Mac Support *Activated* / Upcoming Updates
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Grid Ranger now has support for Intel Macs.  Simply switch to the "intel-mac" branch and all your Grid Ranging dreams will become reality.

Also, I'm starting work on Easy and Hardcore modes for the game.  Controller support should be added soon as well, though I am not sure it's a viable way to play the game.... we will see!

Thanks for reading,

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: GRID RANGER Is Now Available!
notes.notes:

notes.title: / The Grid Ranger Demo is Live & Updated \
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Just in time for (checks notes)... the day AFTER Next Fest, we'd like to announce the 1 level demo of Grid Ranger, available for all prospective Grid Rangers to try.  

We launched it 2 weeks ago, but are just announcing it now.  Why?  Don't ask.  But also, we just made a significant update to it that should improve performance on most machines.   You even have a quality setting in the MENU now in case the game doesn't auto-detect the quality for you correctly.

Give it a shot, and let us know how it goes in the forums!

Thanks,

-Miles @ Pixeljam
